sentence: This project builds a computer-based replica of a patient and a heart-lung machine that estimates oxygen delivery.
This project buys a backup generator and an ultra-low freezer to protect living plant collections at a botanical garden.
This project builds an open data infrastructure that makes ecological and biodiversity data ready for AI research.
This project studies how agents can learn together to make decisions in networked systems, using heterogeneous environments and offline data.
This project studies sharing theorems and ways of counting the parts of discrete mathematical structures, such as polytopes.
This project sets up a center for emerging engineering research and adds courses on quantum computing and the Industrial Internet of Things.
This project develops reactions that use nickel catalysts to form bonds between carbon and sulfur and make sulfoxides.
This project looks at plants and plant pathogens such as fungi, bacteria, viruses and nematodes.
This project studies how short-wavelength lasers interact with inorganic nanoparticles to make very small structures.
This project builds online AI tools that recommend learning paths and help write reference code for programming.
This project uses fiber-optic sensing to measure how waves create pressure gradients that move sand on beaches.
This project builds deep learning methods that combine molecular data and histology images to predict diseases.
This project tries to predict how communities of microbes in thawing permafrost soils change over time, using their DNA.
